         CASE WHEN booked_on >= '2025-12-01' THEN 'Dieser Monat' ELSE 'Letzter Monat' END AS period,

plan.question: Spending of both accounts in 2025 per category as a flow out of one source named 'Income', every amount positive, one row per category, source and target always different, no total row, columns source, target and amount_eur.

sql:
SELECT 'Income' AS source, coalesce(category, 'Needs review') AS target,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS amount_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0
GROUP BY target
ORDER BY amount_eur DESC
